verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing states that its own business account unlocks yield of up to 3.70%, so yield is earned on balances held in the Brex account itself rather than at a separate institution. The evidence is a single marketing line with an unexplained † qualifier, though. Missing for 10: documentation of how the yield works (sweep vs. treasury/money-market), eligibility conditions behind the †, whether operating balances stay liquid while earning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can earn yield on operating cash balances without moving funds to a separate institution

citations.quote: Unlock up to 3.70%†, fast global payments, up to 30x higher credit limits, and cash back with a Brex business account.
Modern cards, banking, expenses, accounting, and more — in 120+ countries.
